description: Policy observation/action contract shared by the frontend (TypeScript), backend (FastAPI) and training (Gymnasium).

coordinate_system.units: world units (1 unit ~ 1 body length of a fish)

observation.raw_units: Clients send RAW world-unit values. Normalization is done only in Python (backend.normalization) so that training and inference share one implementation.
observation.absent_sentinel: When no predator/food exists the relative vector is 0, distance equals max_distance and the *_present flag is 0.

action.direction: unit vector; zero vector is allowed and means 'no preference'
